steps.content: Before her short little legs can even touch the enemy, she gets hit and sent flying. Luckily, she lands safely in someone else's arms.

<size=30>The powers of the Apostle and its clones have stabilized into <color=#fb9259>delusion interference</color>. They devours human's imagination and spiritual power to expel delusions into reality. The actual damage is limited, but when did a dream factory like Dillywood ever see such a fuss?</size>
Fortunately, OwO has a wild imagination to begin with and is unfazed by the Mania. You gently put her behind you, and drop Stella into her arms.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Fall back, my general, and prepare for the climax!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Leave this little minion for the intern clapper.
